description:
Open the BFI-25 personality dataset in Jamovi and run a Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) to test whether the theoretical Big Five factor structure fits the data.

Dataset: /home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/BFI25.csv
This file contains 25 personality items (A1-A5, C1-C5, E1-E5, N1-N5, O1-O5) rated on a 1-6 scale, plus gender and age, from ~2,400 participants (Revelle, 2010).

Steps:
1. Open /home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/BFI25.csv in Jamovi (Menu > Open > Browse).
2. Go to Factor > Confirmatory Factor Analysis.
3. Define 5 factors with these item assignments:
   - Factor 1 (Agreeableness): A1, A2, A3, A4, A5
   - Factor 2 (Conscientiousness): C1, C2, C3, C4, C5
   - Factor 3 (Extraversion): E1, E2, E3, E4, E5
   - Factor 4 (Neuroticism): N1, N2, N3, N4, N5
   - Factor 5 (Openness): O1, O2, O3, O4, O5
4. Ensure Model Fit measures are displayed (CFI, TLI, RMSEA, SRMR).
5. Save the project to /home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/BFI25_CFA.omv
6. Create a text file /home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/CFA_results.txt with fit indices in this exact format:
   CFI: <value>
   TLI: <value>
   RMSEA: <value>
   SRMR: <value>

Replace <value> with the actual numbers from the Jamovi output (e.g., CFI: 0.789).
